versions.changelog:
sonarqube-autofix 1.0.6

- Enhanced integration: Now generates GitHub Issues for each SonarQube SPEC SDD when possible.
- Added support for using `write-specs` skill to author SPECs and `create-issues` for issue tracking if available.
- Improved SonarCloud support: automatically resolves `project_id` from codebase or prompts user if not found.
- Updated environment variable handling and clarified default URL logic for SonarQube Open/SonarCloud.
- Cleanup: Removed obsolete `skill-card.md`.

- Updated SKILL.md to refer to /execute-specs (plural) instead of /execute-spec.
- Removed redundant file: skill-card.md.
- No functional changes to core logic or skill operation.

- Improved security: Added explicit guidance to treat all data downloaded from SonarQube as untrusted input.
- Updated usage instructions: Clarified how to handle issue fields (messages, rule descriptions, code snippets) as data only.
- Removed the redundant or deprecated file `skill-card.md`.
- Bumped version metadata in SKILL.md.

sonarqube-autofix 1.0.3

- Updated SKILL.md with changes to the SPEC implementation hand-off—from `/execute-tdd-spec` to `/execute-spec`.
- Removed skill-card.md from the repository.
- No feature or logic changes to the skill's operation; update is documentation-only.

- Removed file: skill-card.md
- SKILL.md significantly shortened and simplified introduction and description
- No functional or argument changes; documentation now more concise and focused
- Core usage, environment variable setup, stack and framework support, and workflow remain, but with trimmed explanations
- No changes to core process or automation logic; strictly documentation cleanup

- Updated version to 2.0.1 in SKILL.md.
- Removed the file skill-card.md.
- No functional or usage changes; metadata only.

Initial release: Analyze SonarQube issues, classify by type, and auto-generate SPEC SDDs for fixes.

- Supports SonarQube Community, Enterprise, and custom deployments via environment variables.
- Automatically detects project stack (language, manager, test, coverage) for any framework.
- Generates one SPEC SDD per SonarQube issue and invokes /execute-tdd-spec to implement.
- Includes dedicated support for Angular and .NET (scripts, detection, commands, test templates).
- Provides local scan/validation scripts and instructions for smoother SonarQube integration.
